about: Moving-together staging for data/targets.json (design approved by the integrator on 1 October 2026; this branch never edits targets.json). Append `protocolLog` in order. No target label changes are proposed: the rule reads no target quantity; T-PTY-4 is already compromised.

protocolLog.seen: truth probes of the current model (field, seeds 48 and 7, 30-day burn-in + 20 days): crown-visit length, visits per day, arrivals and departures with companions, pair persistence, time alone; the party-size null result (docs/staging/party-size-prereg.md §6). No value under the change (nothing coded or run)
protocolLog.param: Moving-together pre-registration, fixed before any code or run (docs/staging/moving-together-prereg.md). departPersist (field 1, compressed 0; 0 = hash-identical): an initiator of an own trip to a tree that has an audience (own-community animals of 12 y or more within partyLinkM, awake, not its dependants) and that no audience member has joined after departCheckMin 1 min (design) abandons the attempt and stays; its own trips to trees are off its menu for departRetryMin 3.8 min, and once departPersistMaxMin 13 min have passed since the first failed attempt the next attempt is not abandoned (both [M] gruberZuberbuhler2013: re-launch after a mean of 3.80 min, range 0-13 min, 9 cases). Design assumptions: that a failed attempt is abandoned, the audience definition, the check window. Join values, following, trips without an audience and trips to water are unchanged. Fitted: nothing. Checks (field, seeds 48 and 7, on vs off, at most 2 processes): 30-day burn-in + 60 days (observer rows and the crown-visit probe); 30 + 180 days for T-PTY-2 and T-FOOD-6 only if the guard passes. Guard: G1 off hash-identical; G2 T-ACT-1..4 and T-RNG-4 in band; G3 adult and lactating median hunger at most 0.03 above off, no extra starvation; G4 joint departure given a co-feeder higher on than off in each seed; G5 hooed initiations recruiting within 5 min stay within 0.71 +/- 0.05 (C13e fitted row). Predictions (not a gate): bout per crown visit 36-44 min; crown visits per adult-day 4.8-5.5; joint departure given a co-feeder 0.70-0.90; pair together after 60 min 0.70-0.85; time with no companion 0.35-0.50; feeders per occupied crown 1.3-1.6; T-PTY-1 3.0-3.8; T-PTY-4 0.40-0.52; T-RNG-4 2.2-2.7 km; T-ACT-1 0.40-0.43, T-ACT-2 0.17-0.20; adult median hunger +0.00 to +0.03; T-FOOD-6 unchanged 13-18 d; T-PTY-2 patch R² 0.02-0.08. Not resolved: T-RNG-1, T-PTY-3 with fewer than 5 periphery follows, demography. No re-fit is pre-registered
protocolLog.reason: the model's bout length and intake per crown visit match the field (39 min; 13% of a day's need), but 64-66% of visits are solitary and a pair lasts an hour in only 55-60% of cases: an initiator leaves whether or not anyone follows, where field initiators wait, check and re-launch
protocolLog.verdicts: no value yet; T-PTY-1 stays fitted and labelled tuned, not tuned here; held-out rows untuned

protocolLog.param: Amendment to the moving-together pre-registration, before any run. G5 is read per attempt: an attempt recruits if a companion joins it before it ends, at most 5 min (artifacts/validation/party/visit-probe.ts, both arms). Reason: scripts/c13-direction.ts counts a companion who takes up a trip to the same tree within 5 min of an initiation, which with the change on also counts companions who join a re-launch after a failed first attempt; that figure (called, silent, ratio) is reported beside the per-attempt reading and is not the gate. Implementation notes: during the check the initiator stands (waits and checks), a joiner ends the wait at once, an effort not re-launched within departPersistMaxMin of its last failure is over; three lazy chimp.sim keys (tryN, trySince, tryAt); ablation row moving-together; with departPersist 0 the field world is hash-identical to main 9570a3f

protocolLog.seen: development only, seeds 48 and 7, field, departPersist on vs off on main aa950b1, 30-day burn-in + 60 days and + 180 days: T-PTY-1, T-PTY-2, T-PTY-3, T-PTY-4, T-FOOD-6, T-ACT-1..4, T-RNG-4 through the observer; truth reads of crown visits, cohesion, initiations, hunger, deaths and patrols
protocolLog.param: Moving-together result (docs/staging/moving-together-prereg.md §5). Guard passes: G1 off hash-identical to main aa950b1; G2 T-ACT-1 0.425, T-ACT-2 0.195, T-ACT-3 0.131, T-ACT-4 0.360, T-RNG-4 2.59 km (180 d); G3 median hunger +0.003 / +0.019 adults and +0.018 / +0.020 lactating over 180 d, no deaths (60 d: lactating +0.025 / +0.029; the C13 direction script read +0.032 in seed 7 over 60 d and +0.021 over 180 d; the instrument was not named in the pre-registration); G4 joint departure given a co-feeder 0.63 vs 0.58 and 0.57 vs 0.53; G5 hooed attempts recruiting, per attempt, 0.715 / 0.671 (off 0.683 / 0.679). C13e rows: called holds; silent recruitment falls by about 0.03 (0.31 / 0.29 vs 0.34 / 0.34 per attempt), ratio 2.3 vs 2.0. Predictions: 6 pass (bout 37-39 min; crown visits 5.4 / 5.1 per adult-day; T-PTY-4 0.509 vs 0.594; T-RNG-4 2.59 vs 2.80 km; T-ACT-1 and T-ACT-2; adult hunger), 6 fail (joint departure 0.63 / 0.57 vs predicted 0.70-0.90; pair together after 60 min 0.62 / 0.63 vs 0.70-0.85; time with no companion 0.47 / 0.53 vs 0.35-0.50; feeders per occupied crown 1.26 / 1.21 vs 1.3-1.6; T-PTY-1 2.86 (3.03 / 2.69; off 2.51) vs 3.0-3.8; T-PTY-2 patch R² 0.010 vs 0.013 off against 0.02-0.08), and T-FOOD-6 unchanged as predicted (7.5 vs 7.8 d over 6 months; the stated range of 13-18 d was wrong for that window). Truth patrols over 180 d, both seeds: 46 vs 34 patrols (0.30 vs 0.22 per community-week), share reaching 3 adult males 0.67 vs 0.68, adult males per patrol 2.57 vs 2.68. Nothing was tuned or re-fitted
protocolLog.verdicts: development reads only: T-PTY-1 2.51 -> 2.86 (still below 3); the patrol count per community-week rises by a third (C14's fitted quantity)
